page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7nex.2xlarge is a compute-optimized instance from the Enhanced server family, operating under the KVM hypervisor. It is provisioned with 8 vCPUs derived from 4 dedicated physical cores running on a 2.7 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processor, using two threads per core. The instance provides 16.0 GB of memory, which establishes a compute-focused ratio of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Storage is not bundled locally, necessitating the use of remote block storage for persistence. Network interfaces feature a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps, with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included. Acceleration hardware such as GPUs is absent on this model.

Instruction set features for the x86_64 architecture include AVX, AVX-512F, and AVX-512 VNNI, along with cryptographic extensions such as AES, VAES, and SHA-NI. The cache hierarchy provides 48 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1 MB of L2 cache per core, and a shared 48 MB L3 cache. In synthetic performance benchmarks, the instance demonstrates mid-tier computational throughput. It scores 1,842.09 in stress-ng single-core and 7,750.38 in multi-core metrics. Geekbench yields 1,567.0 for single-core and 5,804.0 for multi-core, with specific component scores of 8,100.0 for software compilation using Clang, 9,013.0 for ray tracing, and 5,375.0 for image processing. PassMark tests record an overall CPU score of 11,317.96, an encryption test score of 7,300.05, and an extended instructions score of 6,963.53.

Memory bandwidth measurements demonstrate uncached sequential reads of 58.32 GB/sec and writes of 41.33 GB/sec on 256 MB blocks, reaching 421.06 GB/sec during small cached 16 KB read workloads. Application-level metrics show 7.83 million operations per second in Redis SET tests, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression throughput of 42.04 GB/sec, single-threaded gzip compression at 27.83 GB/sec, and static web serving throughput of 11.46 GB/sec. Given its compute-focused memory allocation, absence of local storage, and 10 Gbps baseline network pipe, ecs.c7nex.2xlarge is suited for continuous compute tasks such as software build farms, batch processing, application middleware, and web serving clusters.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7nex.2xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by a 2.7 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs across 4 physical cores, paired with 16.0 GB of memory (2.0 GB per vCPU) and a 10 Gbps baseline network configuration. The instance does not bundle local disk storage or GPU acceleration. Supported vector instructions include AVX-512F and AVX-512 VNNI alongside hardware encryption extensions. Benchmark results reflect standard middle-tier performance, producing a PassMark CPU score of 11,317.96, Geekbench multi-core score of 5,804.0, and 7.83 million operations per second in Redis SET evaluations. With uncached large-block memory read speeds of 58.32 GB/sec and static web serving throughput of 11.46 GB/sec, ecs.c7nex.2xlarge is configured for compute-oriented workloads, including code compilation, compression routines, web services, and batch data processing.
